problem_patterns.title: Nth Term Forward Calculation & Index Solving
decision_points: Compute common difference d = a_2 - a_1 noting sign
Formulate linear equation in index n
Assert n is a positive integer
common_traps: Off-by-one error using n instead of (n - 1)
Sign errors when common difference d is negative
problem_patterns.deep_structure: Linear relationship between term value and integer index n in an AP
problem_patterns.governing_method: Apply a_n = a + (n-1)d, isolate unknown variable, verify integer validity of index n

problem_patterns.title: Boundary Terms, Term from End & Sign Inversion
decision_points: Distinguish counting from beginning versus counting from terminal end
Solve inequality a + (n-1)d < 0 and round up to next integer for index
common_traps: Inverting inequality sign incorrectly when dividing by negative common difference
Failing to subtract from last term l when counting from the end
problem_patterns.deep_structure: Positional calculation from the terminal end or finding the first negative/positive term boundary
problem_patterns.governing_method: Use a'_m = l - (m-1)d or set inequality a_n < 0 to solve for minimal integer index n

problem_patterns.title: Algebraic Conditions & Symmetrical Term Selections
decision_points: Use symmetrical variables (a-d, a, a+d) when sum of terms is known to cancel d
Use (a-3d, a-d, a+d, a+3d) with step 2d for 4 symmetrical terms
common_traps: Assuming step is d instead of 2d when using symmetrical 4-term representation
Algebraic expansion errors in product relations
problem_patterns.deep_structure: Linear equations formed by multi-term constraints or symmetrical choices (a-d, a, a+d)
problem_patterns.governing_method: Apply 2b = a + c for 3 terms, or solve simultaneous equations for unknown a and d

problem_patterns.title: Series Summation & Quadratic Term Count Determination
decision_points: Check whether last term l is known to use S_n = (n/2)(a+l)
Factorize quadratic equation in n and interpret dual positive integer roots
common_traps: Discarding valid second root when terms from first to second root sum to zero
Omission of 1/2 factor in sum formula
problem_patterns.deep_structure: Summation S_n leading to linear or quadratic relations in term count n
problem_patterns.governing_method: Use S_n = (n/2)[2a + (n-1)d], rearrange to an^2 + bn + c = 0, select valid positive integer roots

problem_patterns.title: Sum Function Decomposition & Ratio of Sums/Terms
decision_points: Differentiate S_n algebraic form to get common difference d = 2A
Replace dummy index n with 2m - 1 to relate sum ratio to m-th term ratio
common_traps: Directly substituting m instead of 2m - 1 in ratio of sums
problem_patterns.deep_structure: Extracting nth term from sum S_n or transforming ratio of sums to ratio of terms via n -> 2m - 1
problem_patterns.governing_method: Use a_n = S_n - S_{n-1} or substitute n = 2m - 1 into ratio of sums expression

problem_patterns.title: Real-World Contexts, Arithmetic Means & Geometric Applications
decision_points: Identify whether the asked quantity is a specific installment (a_n) or total amount (S_n)
Calculate step difference D = (b - a)/(k + 1) for k inserted arithmetic means
common_traps: Confusing total sum S_n with a specific term a_n in word problems
Dividing by k instead of (k + 1) for inserted arithmetic means
problem_patterns.deep_structure: Translating physical distributions, installments, or inserted means into formal AP parameters
problem_patterns.governing_method: Model initial quantity as a, uniform increase as d, and total as S_n; apply AM insertion formula
